run_fastapi_static_server: run a FastAPI server that serves static HTML files from the build/html directory
create_fastapi_app: create a FastAPI application instance for serving static documentation files
mount_static_files: mount a StaticFiles directory at the root path with HTML mode enabled
review_fastapi_static_mount: review the FastAPI app that mounts StaticFiles from build/html as the root route
refactor_static_directory: refactor the FastAPI static file mount to serve from a different directory path
